user.title: Connect a VKmodule Ethernet controller
user.description: Enter the local TCP server address and port configured on your module.

socket2_variant.title: SOCKET-2 / SOCKET-2W
socket2_variant.description: Both models report the same hardware type. Enable the analog input only if this is a SOCKET-2W **and** input 0 is already configured as analog in the module's web interface. The analog input supports 0 to 1 V only.

reconfigure.title: Change VKmodule network address
reconfigure.description: Only the same physical controller (matching UID) will be accepted.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to or read the controller.
error.unsupported_device: The detected controller has no documented commands in this integration.
error.device_mismatch: The controller is not the original device. Check the IP address.
error.analog_unavailable: The analog command is unsupported or the device did not respond. Verify SOCKET-2W and analog mode.
Analog input unavailable. Check module type and configuration.

init.title: VKmodule input options
init.description: Contact inputs use 0 = closed and 1 = open. You can invert their displayed meaning. Analog mode only applies to SOCKET-2W and must also be set in its own web UI.

data.invert_inputs: Invert the displayed digital input states
data.analog_input: Treat input 0 as SOCKET-2W analog (0–1 V)

pulse.name: Pulse relay
pulse.description: Turn on a relay temporarily using its hardware timer.

configure_input.name: Configure input
configure_input.description: Configure input processing and debounce directly in the module.

enabled.name: Process input
enabled.description: Enable or disable digital input processing.

set_relay_mask.name: Set all SOCKET-GIANT relays
set_relay_mask.description: Changes all 16 relay states to the specified bit mask.

mask.name: Relay mask
mask.description: Bit 0 is relay 1. Bit 15 is relay 16.
